intro: Torn between Sukhothai and Ayutthaya? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: Both are former capitals and UNESCO historical parks. Choose Ayutthaya if you want somewhere close to Bangkok (day-trippable), livelier, with ruins amid a working city. Choose Sukhothai for an older, more manicured and serene park that is lovely to cycle — but it is farther (lower north).

blocks.text: Sukhothai vs Ayutthaya at a glance

items: Pick Ayutthaya if you are short on time, based in Bangkok and want an easy day trip among the ruins
Pick Sukhothai if you want an older, serene, beautiful park that is lovely to cycle and do not mind the distance
Choose by route — Ayutthaya pairs with Bangkok; Sukhothai is a stop on the way up to Chiang Mai

faq.q: Sukhothai or Ayutthaya — which is better?
faq.a: Ayutthaya is far more convenient — close to Bangkok and day-trippable, livelier with more amenities. Sukhothai is older, more manicured and serene, ideal for serious history lovers who enjoy a quiet cycle among the ruins.

Yes, but they are in different areas — Ayutthaya is near Bangkok, while Sukhothai is about 5–6 hours farther north. Many visit Ayutthaya from Bangkok, then stop at Sukhothai on the way up to Chiang Mai.

faq.q: Is Ayutthaya a good day trip from Bangkok?
faq.a: Easily — about 1.5 hours from Bangkok by train, minivan or tour, perfect for a day trip. Sukhothai is too far for a day trip and is better with an overnight stay.
